title: ContextEnvelope
description: pcs.v2 minimal Context snapshot evidence (J.5). Every listed field is required. Fields whose inner shape J.5 does not fix (budget_view, index_coverage, permission_view_ref) keep a minimal structural type and will be narrowed by later cards. source_refs and profile_version are optional: J.5 explicitly allows the readable profile_version, and its read_set sentence requires EventRefs to be listed separately as source_refs.

context_id.description: Dedicated context run-account ID, not a RecordRef (J.1).

run_id.description: Dedicated run-account ID, not a RecordRef (J.1).

context_event_seq.description: Event watermark captured with the snapshot (J.5/J.6).

privacy_epoch.description: Privacy barrier generation captured with the snapshot (J.5/J.7).

read_set.description: Each entry is an exact RecordRef plus the Context Engine's usage tag (J.5). The model must not rewrite usage.

memory_hits.description: Exact RecordRefs hit at this snapshot. The hit metadata shape is not fixed by J.5.

unknown_execution_ids.description: Execution accounts whose outcome cannot be verified; unknown is shown, not guessed (J.8).

permission_view_ref.description: Reference to the permission view captured for this run. J.5 does not fix the scheme; it is not a RecordRef.

budget_view.description: Budget view captured for this run. Shape is defined by the run-account layer.

pending_source_event_refs.description: Received but not yet derived source events; all must be carried into the input (J.6).

omissions.description: Explicitly trimmed optional material (J.5). Each entry records why something was left out, and optionally which exact ref it was.

index_generation.description: Search-index generation used by the snapshot (J.5).

index_coverage.description: Coverage report of the index used by the snapshot (J.5). Shape is defined by the retrieval layer.

content_hash.description: Hash of the private fragment payload kept with the snapshot (J.5).

model_input_complete.description: false unless the complete host request was observable (J.5).

source_refs.description: Optional EventRef list, kept separate from read_set per J.5.
